item.title: 🔵 Scaling Security Insights: how we achieved a 10x increase in global scanning capacity
item.description:

Cloudflare Security Insights system now processes over 120 scans per second, providing frequent insights for all customers. By optimizing Kafka consumers, Postgres queries, and our API, we scaled our throughput 10x without adding hardware.

item.title: 🔵 Route public traffic to private applications with Cloudflare
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
